aggregation: For each seed, average the five fold scores with ddof=0. Across seeds, report the mean and the ddof=1 standard deviation. The test block is not used to choose the architecture or the epoch.

summary_rows.std_definition: mean and ddof=1 std across seeds of the ddof=0 mean across 5 folds
summary_rows.note: From-scratch Route A with walk-time edge weights. Inductive training drops test nodes and edges touching them; inductive eval keeps train->train, train->test, and test->test while dropping test->train. Transductive training keeps cross-block edges and still masks test labels.
